title: Graduate Data Analyst
text:
Who we are
Monsoon Retail runs 120 grocery stores across Karnataka.

Responsibilities
- Pull and clean sales data with SQL every week
- Build dashboards in Power BI or Tableau for store managers
- Run simple statistical tests on promotions and explain the results
- Excel at explaining numbers to non-technical people

Requirements
- Strong SQL: joins, aggregations, window functions
- Advanced Excel (pivot tables, lookups)
- Clear written and verbal communication

Good to have
- Python with pandas
- A basic understanding of statistics beyond averages
